notes: §10.3.3: "**Multi-line value form:** after `let x =`, `var x =`, an assignment or `return`, `if_form` and `match_form` are expressions. Each arm yields its **last expression**, and all arms must have the same type. `if` without `else` is not allowed there (K0731)." Stage `parse`: the value position (after `let x =`) and the missing `else` are both syntactic (§8.3, §10.3.3).
